ground_truth.description: The marker-based _extract_inline_script matches the first <script> body containing the sentinel using a regex that does not parse HTML comments, so a commented-out <script> block containing 'mergeQueueDepthChart' is returned before the real partial script. This is a real correctness weakness (self-documented and asserted by test_sentinel_in_commented_script_is_still_matched), though unlikely to bite given real rendered HTML.

`test_ignores_script_tag_inside_html_comment` claims the helper ignores scripts inside HTML comments, but the helper has no comment handling: the commented `<script>var x = 1;</script>` is skipped only because it lacks the sentinel, as the sibling `test_sentinel_in_commented_script_is_still_matched` shows. The test therefore exercises the same mechanism as `test_skips_foreign_script_before_partial` and its name misstates the helper's guarantee.

The new TestExtractInlineScript tests hard-code the literal 'mergeQueueDepthChart' in fixture HTML and assertions (including the error-message check) instead of referencing `_PARTIAL_SCRIPT_SENTINEL`, and repeat the same partial-script and alpine:init fixture snippets inline, so changing the sentinel requires editing several copies.

The sentinel's rationale is written twice (a 6-line comment above `_PARTIAL_SCRIPT_SENTINEL` and a ~20-line helper docstring around a 6-line body); the docstring calls the approach 'immune' and then documents where it is not; and the new test docstrings carry change-history prose for a reviewer ('this test drives the refactor', 'The old position-based re.search...', 'from the task details', a cross-reference to another test by name) that will drift.

When no script carries the sentinel, the AssertionError names the sentinel but not the template (partials/merge_queue.html) that is expected to contain it, so a canvas-id rename surfaces as a helper failure without pointing at its source. Minor.

task.title: test_merge_queue_panel: marker-based script extraction in _extract_inline_script
task.description: Replace the position-based first-script regex in _extract_inline_script with marker-based sentinel selection to make the helper immune to future layout-wrapper changes that prepend other script blocks.
task.details:
In dashboard/tests/test_merge_queue_panel.py around lines 62-72, _extract_inline_script currently uses a regex that grabs the FIRST <script> block in the document. The docstring already acknowledges this is fragile — any future layout wrapper whose <script> appears earlier (e.g. base.html/burndown.html/costs.html alpine:init listeners) would break it.

Switch to marker-based selection: iterate `re.finditer(r'<script[^>]*>(.*?)</script>', content, re.DOTALL)` and return the first match whose body contains a partial-specific sentinel such as 'mergeQueueDepthChart' or 'function renderAll()'. Only fail if no matching script body contains the sentinel.

This also sidesteps a secondary concern: the existing regex would match <script> tags embedded inside HTML comments or string literals if they ever appeared in the partial.

Follow-up from review of task 718 (escalation esc-718-23, triaged after steward timeout).
